_meta.purpose: DAS nevents of the central NanoAODv9 datasets of the 7 ttbar stitching samples, used by scripts/aggregate_validation.py as the completeness criterion (the sum of per-chunk nano_entries must equal this).
_meta.why_in_this_repo: A validation tool carries its own reference data (docs/08 T-23 (7), docs/04 D16).
_meta.source: TTHHAnalyzer/data/samples_2016postVFP_UL.json (the successor of tempTTHH), field 'nevents' (DAS, NtupleForge's dataset records); era 2016 = UL16 postVFP
_meta.cross_check: the lxplus preflight of 2026-10-15 (launch_extend.sh --era 2016, DAS nano nevents) gave the same seven numbers
_meta.keys: Validation short sample names (same as filelists/*<era>/filelist_<short>.txt)
_meta.update_rule: Only change these if the DAS dataset itself changes. A mismatch against a validation run means the run is INCOMPLETE -- do not 'fix' it by editing this file.
